newsitem.title: USA: Malibu sees Q1 revs rise to $4.1 mln.
newsitem.headline: Malibu sees Q1 revs rise to $4.1 mln.

text.p: Malibu Inc said Monday it expects to close its frst quarter that ended September 30 with about $4.1 million in revenue, compared with $1.5 million in revenues for the year-ago period.
The company said it expects to "reach a level of profitability when financials for the first quarter are finalized."
The company is planning to report its results around October 21, said company Chief Financial Officer Andrew Lunetta. Lunetta said quarterly results from the prior-year are unavailable.
